overfishing.def: Catching fish faster than the population can replace them by reproduction, so the stock shrinks year after year. It is a tragedy of the commons in the open ocean.

bycatch.def: Animals caught by fishing gear that were not the target of the catch, such as dolphins, sea turtles, sharks, seabirds and young fish. Much bycatch dies and is thrown back.

fishery-collapse.def: The drop of a fish stock to a small fraction of its former size, so that catches fall sharply and fishing for it is no longer worthwhile. A collapsed stock may take decades to recover, or may not recover.
